_note: Size budgets for the brain. KB = 1024 bytes. Starting values chosen so that a monthly rollover keeps each register readable in one pass; adjust them here. WARN at 80 % of a budget, OVER at 100 %. `rollover` tells the weekly run which method stages a proposal: sections = `##`/`#` sections whose heading starts with a full date (YYYY-MM-DD) older than the first day of the previous month (rollover.py; a register without such headings needs manual); changelog = JSON entries by `when` (rollover.py); manual = the agent splits it by judgement.
